    AI Overview
    The 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four is being held at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana, with semifinals on April 4 and the championship game on April 6, 2026. The teams playing in the 2026 Final Four are UConn, Illinois, Arizona, and Michigan. 
    Key 2026 Final Four Details: 
    • Venue: Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis, Indiana.
    • Semifinal Date: Saturday, April 4, 2026.
    • Championship Date: Monday, April 6, 2026.
    • Teams: Arizona vs. Michigan and UConn vs. Illinois.
    • Context: This marks the fourth time Indianapolis has hosted the Final Four in the Lucas Oil Stadium era. 
    Note: The 2026 Women's Final Four is being held in Phoenix, Arizona.
